title: Mode-2 strict-first total-only fallback qualification

predecessors.ROM1A_parent_run: D01 strict mode-2 failure at step 21

purpose: Qualify a research-only fixed-flux mode-2 strict-first fail-closed representation fallback before any ROM-1A rerun.

per_interval: Compute the prospective representation bound from the accepted pre-solve state before any solver call.
Attempt the exact original mode-2 Reference-floor sample with total balance rate tolerance 1e-12 cm/day.
If the original attempt succeeds, commit exactly that candidate and forbid fallback.
If the original attempt fails, require committed lineage, revision, time and physical state to remain bit-identical.
Reproduce the same failed interval through the direct Reference solver with bottom_mode=2.
Require RETRY_TOTAL_ONLY: zero local-balance flags, zero head flags, max local residual <= 1e-12 and abs(total residual) > 1e-12.
Require abs(total residual)*dt <= the prospective representation bound computed before the failed attempt.
Only then retry the same interval once on a fresh backend with total tolerance max(1e-12, representation_bound_cm/dt).
Require the fallback candidate to satisfy the unchanged 1e-12 cm transaction mass gate and commit exactly one physical advance.
Any other failure class, bound exceedance, diagnostic mismatch or fallback failure is fail-closed.

qualification_matrix.seed: R1 gravity-consistent Se=0.85; two 0.0016-day qeq/qeq mode-2 intervals

if_positive: Rerun ROM-1A under a combined research Reference policy: mode-2 intervals use the D2 strict-first fallback and mode-5 intervals retain ROM-0R-R3D4. History definitions, dt and all non-total solver controls remain frozen.
